sahneler.metin: In a November storm, a huge freighter broke in two on Lake Michigan.
It sank in minutes, and almost the entire crew was killed.
The ship was sailing empty, heading home.
Its hull had been damaged in an earlier grounding.
Storm waves flexed the long, ageing ship.
A crack opened amidships and ran across the hull.
Two men survived on a raft through the night.
The Coast Guard reviewed inspections of old lake freighters.

aciklama:
Carl D. Bradley broke in two on Lake Michigan. The cause: hull failure amidships in heavy seas, with brittle steel and prior damage suspected.
